responsibility: This file implements the PRU backend’s target-specific GIMPLE pass for TI ABI conformance checking. It registers an early function pass that runs only under the TI PRU ABI and walks each function body and signature to diagnose constructs GCC cannot safely emit in TI-compatible form, especially large return-by-memory values and arguments, aggregates, arrays, or pointers involving function pointers; it therefore owns the backend’s frontloaded ABI-validation diagnostics rather than code generation itself.
